config:
Inspect or update Agent Soul-backed config assets through the Agent Stub.

Usage:
  dify-agent config [command]

Available Commands:
  env         Update config env variables visible to the current run.
  files       Pull or update config files through the Agent Stub.
  manifest    Show the current visible Agent config manifest as JSON.
  note        Pull or update the current config note.
  skills      Pull or update config skills through the Agent Stub.

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for config

Use "dify-agent config [command] --help" for more information about a command.
config env:
Update config env variables visible to the current run.

Usage:
  dify-agent config env [command]

Available Commands:
  push        Set or delete config env entries from one local dotenv file or stdin.

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for env

Use "dify-agent config env [command] --help" for more information about a command.
config env push:
Set or delete config env entries from one local dotenv file or stdin.

Usage:
  dify-agent config env push PATH|- [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for push
config files:
Pull or update config files through the Agent Stub.

Usage:
  dify-agent config files [command]

Available Commands:
  delete      Delete one or more config files by name without touching local files.
  pull        Pull one or all visible config files into ./.dify_conf/files by default.
  push        Upload one or more local files into the current config manifest.

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for files

Use "dify-agent config files [command] --help" for more information about a command.

file:
Upload or download workflow files through the Agent Stub.

Usage:
  dify-agent file [command]

Available Commands:
  download    Download one workflow file mapping into the local sandbox directory.
  public-url  Create a browser-visible download URL for an existing ToolFile reference.
  upload      Upload one sandbox-local file as a ToolFile output reference.

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for file

Use "dify-agent file [command] --help" for more information about a command.
file download:
Download one workflow file mapping into the local sandbox directory.

Usage:
  dify-agent file download TRANSFER_METHOD REFERENCE_OR_URL [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help        help for download
      --to string   Local directory for the downloaded file.
file public-url:
Create a browser-visible download URL for an existing ToolFile reference.

Usage:
  dify-agent file public-url REFERENCE [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for public-url
file upload:
Upload one sandbox-local file as a ToolFile output reference.

Usage:
  dify-agent file upload PATH [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help               help for upload
      --no-download-link   Skip creating a public download link after upload.
knowledge:
Autonomously inspect read-only KnowledgeFS evidence. All results are JSON.

Usage:
  dify-agent knowledge [flags]
  dify-agent knowledge [command]

Available Commands:
  capabilities Inspect this space's current capabilities (no model credentials).
  cat          Read a page of text. Raw manifests and binary artifacts are not exposed.
  diff         Compare two readable paths without an LLM semantic-diff call.
  find         Find /knowledge entries whose names contain the query.
  grep         Search text inside /knowledge with a bounded server timeout.
  image        Deliver one bounded image to a vision-capable Agent via the trusted runtime channel.
  images       List image items and captions from a receipt's immutable document artifact.
  ls           List a bounded page of /knowledge entries.
  open         Open a node ID or validate/reopen a trusted evidence receipt.
  search       Retrieve evidence using the space profile; no nested planner or generated answer.
  spaces       List only spaces bound to this Agent and their current availability.
  stat         Inspect safe metadata for one /knowledge path.
  tree         Browse a bounded /knowledge subtree.

Flags:
  -h, --help               help for knowledge
      --protocol-version   Print the locally supported knowledge protocol version.

Use "dify-agent knowledge [command] --help" for more information about a command.
knowledge capabilities:
Inspect this space's current capabilities (no model credentials).

Usage:
  dify-agent knowledge capabilities [flags]

Flags:
      --command-id string   Logical UUID for this command; generated by default. Reusing it will not repeat retrieval.
  -h, --help                help for capabilities
      --json                Emit complete JSON (always enabled). (default true)
      --space string        Knowledge command space.
knowledge cat:
Read a page of text. Raw manifests and binary artifacts are not exposed.

Usage:
  dify-agent knowledge cat [flags]

Flags:
      --command-id string   Logical UUID for this command; generated by default. Reusing it will not repeat retrieval.
      --cursor string       Knowledge command cursor.
  -h, --help                help for cat
      --json                Emit complete JSON (always enabled). (default true)
      --limit int           Maximum returned items/segments (1–50); retrieval depth still belongs to the space profile. (default 10)
      --path string         Canonical read-only /knowledge path. (default "/knowledge")
      --space string        Knowledge command space.
